intro: From 29 articles published between 2026-04-13 and 2026-08-13, this archive covers privilege-escalation vulnerabilities across enterprise, technology, education, government, and healthcare sectors. Chaotic Eclipse and Lazarus Group were observed as top threat actors. Key vulnerabilities include CVE-2026-8950, CVE-2026-8956, and CVE-2026-8957, each with a CVSS score of 9.8, alongside CVE-2026-34659 and CVE-2026-34660 at 9.6. Coverage spans Global, Brazil, France, Germany, and India, with a severity mix of 22 high, 3 medium, and 4 critical incidents.
